name: pinterest-nurture-browse
description: Nurture browse 0.2.1: headed default, continuous randomized mouse trails, inertial scroll, personas (browse_only/light_like/deep_browse/bounce_early), pins 1–12, like 15–40% (0 likes OK), log-normal pauses, quiet window. Prefer python_runner. One account ↔ one geo/proxy. Pipeline: register → nurture same job.

steps.text: Requires logged-in persistent profile (cookies). Do not wipe user_data_dir. Stop on unauth CTA / account deactivated. 0.2.1 behavior: default headed (--headless opt-in, Xvfb OK); continuous random mouse trails then mousedown/mouseup (never locator.click / force click); inertial scroll; personas; log-normal pauses; quiet window after load; no fill for human fields.

If name/gender onboarding appears, complete each step (gender: Male/Female 50/50); if [data-test-id=desktop-use-case-picker], click 3+ [data-test-id^=use-case-tap-area-], then [data-test-id=skip-or-continue-button]. Do not Escape while onboarding is up.
Assert logged-in: no unauth-header/simple-login-button; prefer header-accounts-options-button / pin feed links.
Feed: inertial scroll + ambient mouse (python_runner). skill_steps cannot pick random pins or trails well.
